heard: A very large assembly gathered around Men, women, and children all in the crowd Weeping bitterly before the house of God Confessing our sins as the tears did flow Sheikah Naya spoke up from the Elam line We have been unfaithful, a God divine Yet now there is hope for Israel still Send away all these women as we will Only Jonathan and Jai, they oppose this Meshulam and Shabbat I stood with his They trembled at the command of God
